meta.notes: Four collectible keys, each a one-time pickup that grants a permanent buff. Cards show the key name, its color, and the buff it grants. The two carry-capacity keys stack with each other. Per-key in-game icons are not reliably available without in-game capture, so the catalog launches image-light.

items.name: Crimson Octagon
items.effect: Permanently increases your jump height, helping you reach raised platforms and shortcuts.
items.cardSummary: The Crimson Octagon is a red key that permanently raises your jump height, making elevated areas easier to reach.

items.name: Golden Diamond
items.effect: Permanently increases your carry capacity by 3, the largest single carry boost.
items.cardSummary: The Golden Diamond is a gold key that adds +3 carry capacity, letting you hold more books per trip.

items.name: Azure Star
items.effect: Permanently increases your carry capacity by 2, and stacks with the Golden Diamond.
items.cardSummary: The Azure Star is a blue key that adds +2 carry capacity. It stacks with the Golden Diamond for more carrying room.

items.name: Emerald Club
items.effect: Permanently grants sprint, letting you move faster across the library.
items.cardSummary: The Emerald Club is a green key that unlocks faster movement, speeding up long trips across the library.
